method: Ideal horizontal centre-range only, one-unit midpoint bins; gun/Arc48/72, inactive gun96 and silo72/96/120. Separate production geometry/LOS/pitch/contact/flight reports govern selected designs. Each plot is an independent alternative; overlapping route intervals are not additive damage.

options.title: Orchard and Crescent Tour
options.rationale: The west approach returns north between the orchard mound and crescent pond, then bends through the central garden and around the southern grove. The long southern return offers a later encounter with its own court; the original pond, both mounds and all supported bird trees stay intact.

rejectedSites.reason: route, terrain or retained bird perch

options.title: Southern Orchard Circuit
options.rationale: An eastward central traverse and southern loop minimise intervention near the crescent pond, but omit the stronger northern return and make the eastern court one long continuous exposure. This is the shorter, less varied alternative.

options.title: Fallen Arch Return
options.rationale: A northern entry reaches the original arch garden, turns west into a broad early court, then returns around two central courts before an eastern descent and independent southern catch. The southwest stream and its raised grove remain uninterrupted scenery rather than an obligatory crossing.

options.title: Stream and Arch Crossing
options.rationale: A southwestern approach crosses the stream on a three-box timber span, then visits the arch garden and eastern court. It gives the western bank a role but bypasses the northern land and requires more clearing beside the supported southwest bird tree.

rejectedSites.reason: route, terrain or retained bird perch

options.title: Lantern Shore Return
options.rationale: The northern mainland turns toward the mere before returning west across two garden courts. A southern shore descent and final eastward turn create a late catch beyond the early northern sites. The large eastern lake, western mounds and supported trees remain prominent; the route uses the reachable mainland without an excessive lake deck.

options.title: Western Grove Circuit
options.rationale: A northern entrance bends around the western grove and along the southern mainland. It retains the lake entirely but spends more travel on the narrow western strip and bypasses the shore garden. Its strongest late court repeats much of the southern exposure rather than adding a distinct shore encounter.

rejectedSites.reason: route, terrain or retained bird perch

options.title: Crown River Tour
options.rationale: A western garden hook reaches one short two-box bridge across the original river. The eastern bank climbs to the north garden, returns through a second court, then descends to a southern catch before the large southeast mound. Bank-specific early choices, central repeat exposures and a late corridor have distinct roles.

options.title: Eastern Crown Circuit
options.rationale: The shorter alternative stays on the broad east bank, circling below the northern crown grove before a central and southern return. It avoids a bridge but leaves the western garden outside the journey and concentrates too much investment on one bank.
